hook: Telangana splits into *3* growth zones: CURE, PURE, RARE
hook_b: Telangana splits into *3* growth zones: CURE, PURE, RARE
tldr: At the IRC inaugural session, CM Revanth Reddy said CURE (inside ORR) will focus on services, PURE (between ORR and RRR) on manufacturing, and RARE (beyond RRR) on agriculture. He invited delegates to the Invest Telangana Global Summit at Bharat Future City, Dec 7-9.

beats.what: The CM laid out three development regions tied to the ring roads.
beats.why: The government says road connectivity will drive growth, citing ORR.
beats.care: Where you live may decide whether your area is planned for services, factories or farming.
